title: English Conversation 34:  Taking the Stairs
content: 1. to take the stairs: to go up or down by using the stairs - The elevator is broken, so we need to take the stairs. - I take the stairs because it is good exercise. 2. I'll come with you.: a sentence used to show that you will go together with another person. A) I'm going to get some food. B) I'm hungry, too. I'll come with you. A) I'm going to take a walk. B) I need a break. I'll come with you. 3. high heels: shoes with high heels that are worn by women - High heels are very uncomfortable. - High heels are very fashionable.
